lines.text: The LORD tells Joshua to circle the city once a day for six days, then seven times on day seven.
On the seventh day they rise at noon, circle the city seven times, and Joshua commands a shout.
Joshua sends the seven priests into Rahab's house, and they bring out her family and settle them outside the camp.

wrong_details.wrong: The seven priests with the horns
wrong_details.true: The two men who spied out the land
